issues.explanation: docs/api/totem.md keeps the old proposal status line alongside the new implemented status, leaving contradictory status text.

conventions.evidence: app/Actions/PairTotem.php:127 transaction+lockForUpdate reuses IssueTicket with TicketChannel::Totem (TicketController.php:586); migrations include down() (e.g. 2026_10_29_051228); login_code_* deliberately non-fillable via #[Fillable] + forceFill; Log::channel('audit') without code; docs + CHANGELOG updated

readability.evidence: app/Actions/PairTotem.php:119, app/Http/Middleware/AuthenticateTotem.php:617, app/Models/TotemPreset.php:810 small focused methods with PHPDoc; consistent naming; one stale proposal status line remains in docs/api/totem.md

requirements.evidence: change.diff:1178 totems/presets/join schema; OpenTotemPairingWindow random_int+zero-pad+10min; AuthController /\A\d{6}\z/ ->400; PairTotem locked consume ->401 no-oracle, totem create+JWT with totem_id/entity_id/preset_id/queues/iat/exp/jti; throttles 10/min + totem-ticket 30/min rendered as rate_limited; AuthenticateTotem invalid_token+intersection+last_seen_at; TotemContext 403/404 rules; queue/priority/ticket shapes incl. sequential A001 and TotemPriority 0/10/20; CORS localhost/127.0.0.1+TOTEM_WEB_ORIGIN no credentials; phpunit secret+TTL, .env.example, routes/api.php, factories, totem:pairing-code

scope.evidence: every hunk serves pairing/JWT/scoped endpoints/rate-limit/CORS/config/docs/tests; no operator UI, billing, refresh tokens, per-entity priorities

security.evidence: AuthenticateTotem.php:627-659 type-checks claims, rechecks totem/preset is_active, entity agreement, single invalid_token + WWW-Authenticate; no oracle in PairTotem; forceFill for system fields; secret >=32 enforced; throttle keyed by sha256(bearerToken); CORS supports_credentials false, no ACAO for evil origin (tests)

simplicity.evidence: reuses IssueTicket, firebase/php-jwt, existing InactiveQueueException/ThrottleRequestsException rendering; Context/Token/PairedTotem are minimal value objects; no service layer or duplication

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/Totem/PairTotemTest.php format/401/reuse/regen/throttle/audit/CORS; PairingCodeCommandTest zero-pad/replace/unknown/inactive/audit; TotemAuthenticationTest malformed/wrong-secret/expired/deactivated/deleted/soft-deleted/last_seen; TotemQueueListing/PriorityListing/TicketIssuance incl. scope intersection, inactive_queue, invalid_priority, float rejection, sequential codes, per-totem throttle

review.summary: Implements the full totem BFF: pairing window, JWT auth, scoped queues/priorities/ticket issuance via IssueTicket, throttles, CORS and docs. No material gaps found; only a stale proposal status line remains in docs/api/totem.md.
